gaps.GET /v1/pipelines/catalogue: the pipeline step catalogue: the steps that run today as workflow stages and the planned ADR-0232 steps, with each step's governed primitive and write class
gaps.POST /v1/pipeline-runs: starts a pipeline run of the live version of a workflow template through the workflow engine's start path (idempotency key, project attribution, compliance cascade)
gaps.GET /v1/pipeline-runs: lists pipeline runs under the list contract, each settled from its workflow instance and carrying its lifecycle
